registration.scope: A query-local dense lookup of the already constructed land-siege exclusion set. Preserve the set itself, non-land routing, all route ordering, water-goal exception, and unindexable-position fallback. No game rule, strategy, gene, forcing, pin, or verification-policy changes.
registration.registration_boundary: Before production edits, either local build, or any new timing arm. Two test-only oracle controls have been authored together with this registration and will first run against unchanged production.
registration.profile: cargo build --profile ci --locked --bin civvis_orders -j 4, same rustc and local task target for both builds. Local CI profile only, not a Native artifact speed claim.
registration.workload: Exactly the existing 41 historical Emperor opening prefixes, turns 160 through 200, from docs/performance/2026-10-16-native-route-dense-visits.json registration. Original input in docs/performance/2026-10-15-native-base-world-cost.input.events.jsonl.gz. Reuse exact 283 common arguments from the previous fixed protocol receipts.

design.order: All AA pairs then all AB pairs; each phase has two interleaves, alternating AB/BA with reversed first arm in the second interleave.
design.metric: Fresh persistent child user plus system CPU, including startup, protocol and input-capture writes; parent hash/input reconstruction excluded. 48 children, 1968 full responses. No replacements, filtering, extension or early outcome review.
design.acceptance: Every full parsed response identical after removing only top-level input_capture; all actual captured prefixes exactly equal originals; median and pooled paired AB CPU deltas negative; absolute AB median exceeds absolute AA median, AA IQR and AB IQR. All semantic controls and full local CI suite pass. Otherwise withdraw the production optimization and publish the fixed result.
design.ambient: Normal host services and games continue; no owned build/test/headless/profile workload during timing. Record ambient processes at pair boundaries. Existing live verification is not interrupted.

registration.limitations: One historical world on local ARM64 hardware in the CI profile. Exact-order compatibility and CPU only: no fresh Native game, Deity win, strength gain, or overall game-speed claim. No additional compatibility-game cohort is claimed.

final_disposition: Withdraw the experimental production optimization. Retain two cfg(test)-only oracle controls and all fixed negative evidence. The final production inputs match the original baseline byte for byte.
